propositions: Cancelled or timed-out jobs in the Verified Gate cast Verified -1 with a generic 'CANCELLED: <url>' message that names no job and gives no reason, making triage require manual inspection of the run.

The gerrit-review-action has no input for custom message text; it self-builds 'STATUS: SERVER_URL/REPOSITORY/actions/runs/RUN_ID' as a label-only message, so enriched detail cannot be delivered through that action.

A dedicated SSH 'gerrit review --message' step posts a summary of non-successful jobs (naming each, distinguishing TIMED OUT vs CANCELLED vs FAILED, reporting duration and html_url) as a comment-only review with no label, after the vote is already cast.

The workflow fetches both this run's job list and per-job GitHub annotations, with the summary stripping single quotes and control characters to prevent command injection when job names derive from patchset-controlled shard config.
Both new comment steps are continue-on-error and guarded on vote-type != success, so a fault in the comment path leaves the Verified vote already cast and cannot redden a passing run.
